<?php
final class Atom {
    public function __construct(public string $name) {
    }
}
final class Pair {
    public function __construct(public mixed $car, public mixed $cdr) {
    }
}
final class Marker {
    public function __construct(public string $kind) {
    }
}
$nil = new Marker('nil');
$void = new Marker('void');
$uninit = new Marker('uninitialized');
$symbols = [];
function sym(string $s): Atom {
    global $symbols;
    return $symbols[$s]??=new Atom($s);
}
function makeList(array $a, mixed $tail = null): mixed {
    global $nil;
    if ($tail === null)$tail = $nil;
    for ($i = count($a)-1; $i >= 0; $i--)$tail = new Pair($a[$i], $tail);
    return $tail;
}
function items(mixed $v): ?array {
    global $nil;
    $a = [];
    while ($v instanceof Pair){
        $a[] = $v->car;
        $v = $v->cdr;
    }
    return $v === $nil?$a: null;
}
function rep(mixed $v, bool $quoted = true): string {
    global $nil, $void;
    if ($v === $nil)return '()';
    if ($v === $void)return '#<void>';
    if (is_bool($v))return $v?'#t': '#f';
    if (is_int($v))return (string)$v;
    if (is_string($v))return $quoted?'"'.str_replace(["\\", '"', "\n"], ["\\\\", '\\"', '\\n'], $v).'"': $v;
    if ($v instanceof Atom)return $v->name;
    if ($v instanceof Procedure)return $v->name !== null?'#<procedure '.$v->name.'>': '#<procedure>';
    $a = [];
    while ($v instanceof Pair){
        $a[] = rep($v->car, $quoted);
        $v = $v->cdr;
    }
    if ($v !== $nil){
        $a[] = '.';
        $a[] = rep($v, $quoted);
    }
    return '('.implode(' ', $a).')';
}
function same(mixed $a, mixed $b, bool $deep = false): bool {
    if ($deep && $a instanceof Pair && $b instanceof Pair)return same($a->car, $b->car, true) && same($a->cdr, $b->cdr, true);
    return $a === $b;
}
final class Env {
    public array $frame = [];
    public function __construct(public ?Env $parent = null) {
    }
    public function find(string $n): Env {
        for ($e = $this; $e !== null; $e = $e->parent)if (array_key_exists($n, $e->frame))return $e;
        throw new Exception('unbound variable: '.$n);
    }
    public function get(string $n): mixed {
        global $uninit;
        $v = $this->find($n)->frame[$n];
        if ($v === $uninit)throw new Exception('uninitialized variable: '.$n);
        return $v;
    }
}
final class Procedure {
    public function __construct(public ?string $name, public int $minimum, public bool|string $rest, public ?Closure $fn = null, public array $params = [], public array $body = [], public ?Env $env = null) {
    }
    public function call(array $a): mixed {
        if (count($a)<$this->minimum || ($this->rest === false && count($a) !== $this->minimum))throw new Exception(($this->name??'lambda').': wrong number of arguments (expected '.($this->rest !== false?'at least ': '').$this->minimum.', got '.count($a).')');
        if ($this->fn !== null)return ($this->fn)($a);
        $e = new Env($this->env);
        foreach($this->params as $i=>$n)$e->frame[$n] = $a[$i];
        if (is_string($this->rest))$e->frame[$this->rest] = makeList(array_slice($a, $this->minimum));
        return evalBody($this->body, $e);
    }
}
function parameters(mixed $v): ?array {
    global $nil;
    $names = [];
    while ($v instanceof Pair){
        if (!($v->car instanceof Atom))return null;
        $names[] = $v->car->name;
        $v = $v->cdr;
    }
    if ($v !== $nil && !($v instanceof Atom))return null;
    $rest = $v instanceof Atom?$v->name: false;
    $all = $rest === false?$names: [...$names, $rest];
    return count(array_unique($all)) === count($all)?[$names, $rest]: null;
}
function bindings(mixed $v, bool $unique): ?array {
    $a = items($v);
    if ($a === null)return null;
    $bs = [];
    $seen = [];
    foreach($a as $x){
        $z = items($x);
        if ($z === null || count($z) !== 2 || !($z[0] instanceof Atom))return null;
        $n = $z[0]->name;
        if ($unique && isset($seen[$n]))return null;
        $seen[$n] = true;
        $bs[] = [$n, $z[1]];
    }
    return $bs;
}
function shape(bool $ok, mixed $x): void {
    if (!$ok)throw new Exception('bad syntax: '.rep($x));
}
function compound(array $p, array $b, Env $e, ?string $name = null): Procedure {
    return new Procedure($name, count($p[0]), $p[1], null, $p[0], $b, $e);
}
function evalBody(array $a, Env $e): mixed {
    global $void;
    $v = $void;
    foreach($a as $x)$v = evaluate($x, $e);
    return $v;
}
function evaluate(mixed $x, Env $e): mixed {
    global $nil, $void, $uninit;
    if ($x instanceof Atom)return $e->get($x->name);
    if (!($x instanceof Pair)){
        shape($x !== $nil, $x);
        return $x;
    }
    $a = items($x);
    shape($a !== null, $x);
    $n = count($a);
    $h = $a[0] instanceof Atom?$a[0]->name: '';
    switch ($h){
        case 'quote': shape($n === 2, $x);
            return $a[1];
        case 'if': shape($n === 3 || $n === 4, $x);
            return evaluate($a[1], $e) !== false?evaluate($a[2], $e): ($n === 4?evaluate($a[3], $e): $void);
        case 'begin': return evalBody(array_slice($a, 1), $e);
        case 'lambda': $p = $n >= 3?parameters($a[1]): null;
            shape($p !== null, $x);
            return compound($p, array_slice($a, 2), $e);
        case 'define':
            if (($a[1]??null) instanceof Atom){
                shape($n === 3, $x);
                $v = evaluate($a[2], $e);
                if ($v instanceof Procedure && $v->fn === null && $v->name === null)$v->name = $a[1]->name;
                $e->frame[$a[1]->name] = $v;
            }
            else{
                $t = $a[1]??null;
                $p = $n >= 3 && $t instanceof Pair && $t->car instanceof Atom?parameters($t->cdr): null;
                shape($p !== null, $x);
                $e->frame[$t->car->name] = compound($p, array_slice($a, 2), $e, $t->car->name);
            }
            return $void;
        case 'set!': shape($n === 3 && $a[1] instanceof Atom, $x);
            $v = evaluate($a[2], $e);
            $e->find($a[1]->name)->frame[$a[1]->name] = $v;
            return $void;
        case 'let': case 'let*': case 'letrec':
            $named = $h === 'let' && ($a[1]??null) instanceof Atom;
            $at = $named?2: 1;
            $bs = $n >= $at+2?bindings($a[$at], $h !== 'let*'): null;
            shape($bs !== null, $x);
            $scope = new Env($e);
            if ($h === 'let*'){
                $scope = $bs?$e: $scope;
                foreach($bs as [$name, $expr]){
                    $v = evaluate($expr, $scope);
                    $scope = new Env($scope);
                    $scope->frame[$name] = $v;
                }
            }
            elseif($h === 'letrec'){
                foreach($bs as [$name])$scope->frame[$name] = $uninit;
                foreach($bs as [$name, $expr])$scope->frame[$name] = evaluate($expr, $scope);
            }
            else{
                $vs = [];
                foreach($bs as $b)$vs[] = evaluate($b[1], $e);
                if ($named){
                    $p = compound([array_column($bs, 0), false], array_slice($a, 3), $scope, $a[1]->name);
                    $scope->frame[$a[1]->name] = $p;
                    return $p->call($vs);
                }
                foreach($bs as $i=>$b)$scope->frame[$b[0]] = $vs[$i];
            }
            return evalBody(array_slice($a, $at+1), $scope);
        case 'cond':
            $cs = array_map('items', array_slice($a, 1));
            foreach($cs as $i=>$c)shape($c !== null && count($c)>0 && (!($c[0] instanceof Atom) || $c[0]->name !== 'else' || (count($c) >= 2 && $i === count($cs)-1)), $x);
            foreach($cs as $c){
                if ($c[0] === sym('else'))return evalBody(array_slice($c, 1), $e);
                $v = evaluate($c[0], $e);
                if ($v !== false)return count($c) === 1?$v: evalBody(array_slice($c, 1), $e);
            }
            return $void;
        case 'and': $v = true;
            foreach(array_slice($a, 1) as $z){
                $v = evaluate($z, $e);
                if ($v === false)break;
            }
            return $v;
        case 'or': foreach(array_slice($a, 1) as $z){
            $v = evaluate($z, $e);
            if ($v !== false)return $v;
        }
        return false;
        case 'when': case 'unless': shape($n >= 3, $x);
            return (evaluate($a[1], $e) !== false) === ($h === 'when')?evalBody(array_slice($a, 2), $e): $void;
    }
    $f = evaluate($a[0], $e);
    $args = [];
    foreach(array_slice($a, 1) as $z)$args[] = evaluate($z, $e);
    if (!($f instanceof Procedure))throw new Exception('not a procedure: '.rep($f));
    return $f->call($args);
}
$mid = false;
function writeText(string $s): void {
    global $mid;
    echo $s;
    if ($s !== '')$mid = !str_ends_with($s, "\n");
}
function writeLine(string $s): void {
    global $mid;
    if ($mid)writeText("\n");
    writeText($s."\n");
}
function expect(string $n, mixed $v, string $kind): mixed {
    $ok = match($kind){
        'integer'=>is_int($v), 'string'=>is_string($v), 'pair'=>$v instanceof Pair, 'procedure'=>$v instanceof Procedure, 'list'=>items($v) !== null
    };
    if (!$ok)throw new Exception("$n: expected $kind, got ".rep($v));
    return $v;
}
function globalEnv(): Env {
    global $nil, $void;
    $e = new Env();
    $add = function($n, $m, $r, $fn)use($e){
        $e->frame[$n] = new Procedure($n, $m, $r, $fn);
    };
    foreach(['+', '*', '-', 'quotient', 'remainder', 'modulo', 'abs', 'min', 'max', 'gcd', '=', '<', '>', '<=', '>='] as $name){
        $fixed = in_array($name, ['quotient', 'remainder', 'modulo'], true)?2: ($name === 'abs'?1: null);
        $add($name, $fixed??(in_array($name, ['+', '*', 'gcd'], true)?0: 1), $fixed === null, function($a)use($name){
            foreach($a as $v)expect($name, $v, 'integer');
            switch ($name){
                case '+': return array_sum($a);
                case '*': return array_product($a);
                case '-': return count($a) === 1?-$a[0]: $a[0]-array_sum(array_slice($a, 1));
                case 'abs': return abs($a[0]);
                case 'min': return min($a);
                case 'max': return max($a);
                case 'gcd': $g = 0;
                    foreach($a as $v){
                        $v = abs($v);
                        while ($v !== 0){
                            $t = $g%$v;
                            $g = $v;
                            $v = $t;
                        }
                    }
                    return $g;
                case 'quotient': case 'remainder': case 'modulo': if ($a[1] === 0)throw new Exception($name.': division by zero');
                    $q = intdiv($a[0], $a[1]);
                    $r = $a[0]-$a[1]*$q;
                    if ($name === 'quotient')return $q;
                    if ($name === 'modulo' && $r !== 0 && (($r<0) !== ($a[1]<0)))$r += $a[1];
                    return $r;
            }
            for ($i = 1; $i<count($a); $i++)if (!match($name){
                '='=>$a[$i-1] === $a[$i], '<'=>$a[$i-1]<$a[$i], '>'=>$a[$i-1]>$a[$i], '<='=>$a[$i-1] <= $a[$i], '>='=>$a[$i-1] >= $a[$i]
            })return false;
            return true;
        });
    }
    $add('not', 1, false, fn($a)=>$a[0] === false);
    $add('eq?', 2, false, fn($a)=>same($a[0], $a[1]));
    $add('equal?', 2, false, fn($a)=>same($a[0], $a[1], true));
    foreach(['null?', 'pair?', 'list?', 'number?', 'symbol?', 'procedure?'] as $name)$add($name, 1, false, fn($a)=>match($name){
        'null?'=>$a[0] === $nil, 'pair?'=>$a[0] instanceof Pair, 'list?'=>items($a[0]) !== null, 'number?'=>is_int($a[0]), 'symbol?'=>$a[0] instanceof Atom, 'procedure?'=>$a[0] instanceof Procedure
    });
    $add('cons', 2, false, fn($a)=>new Pair($a[0], $a[1]));
    $add('list', 0, true, fn($a)=>makeList($a));
    foreach(['car', 'cdr', 'cadr'] as $name)$add($name, 1, false, function($a)use($name){
        $p = expect($name, $a[0], 'pair');
        return match($name){
            'car'=>$p->car, 'cdr'=>$p->cdr, 'cadr'=>expect($name, $p->cdr, 'pair')->car
        };
    });
    foreach(['length', 'reverse', 'list-ref'] as $name)$add($name, $name === 'list-ref'?2: 1, false, function($a)use($name){
        $ls = items(expect($name, $a[0], 'list'));
        if ($name === 'length')return count($ls);
        if ($name === 'reverse')return makeList(array_reverse($ls));
        $k = expect($name, $a[1], 'integer');
        if ($k<0 || $k >= count($ls))throw new Exception('list-ref: index out of range: '.$k);
        return $ls[$k];
    });
    $add('append', 0, true, function($a)use($nil){
        if (!$a)return $nil;
        $z = [];
        foreach(array_slice($a, 0, -1) as $v)$z = [...$z, ...items(expect('append', $v, 'list'))];
        return makeList($z, $a[count($a)-1]);
    });
    foreach(['map', 'filter', 'fold-left', 'apply'] as $name)$add($name, $name === 'fold-left'?3: 2, $name !== 'filter', function($a)use($name){
        $f = expect($name, $a[0], 'procedure');
        if ($name === 'apply')return $f->call([...array_slice($a, 1, -1), ...items(expect($name, $a[count($a)-1], 'list'))]);
        $ls = [];
        foreach(array_slice($a, $name === 'fold-left'?2: 1) as $v)$ls[] = items(expect($name, $v, 'list'));
        $out = [];
        $acc = $a[1];
        $count = min(array_map('count', $ls));
        for ($i = 0; $i<$count; $i++){
            if ($name === 'filter'){
                if ($f->call([$ls[0][$i]]) !== false)$out[] = $ls[0][$i];
            }else{
                $z = [];
                foreach($ls as $l)$z[] = $l[$i];
                if ($name === 'map')$out[] = $f->call($z);
                else $acc = $f->call([$acc, ...$z]);
            }
        }
        return $name === 'fold-left'?$acc: makeList($out);
    });
    $add('string-append', 0, true, fn($a)=>implode('', array_map(fn($v)=>expect('string-append', $v, 'string'), $a)));
    $add('number->string', 1, false, fn($a)=>(string)expect('number->string', $a[0], 'integer'));
    $add('display', 1, false, function($a)use($void){
        writeText(rep($a[0], false));
        return $void;
    });
    $add('newline', 0, false, function($a)use($void){
        writeText("\n");
        return $void;
    });
    $add('error', 1, true, function($a){
        throw new Exception(expect('error', $a[0], 'string').implode('', array_map(fn($v)=>' '.rep($v), array_slice($a, 1))));
    });
    return $e;
}
final class Reader {
    private int $row = 0, $col = 0;
    public function __construct(private array $lines) {
    }
    public function skip(): void {
        $this->row++;
        $this->col = 0;
    }
    public function end(): bool {
        while ($this->row<count($this->lines)){
            $s = $this->lines[$this->row];
            while (($s[$this->col]??null) === ' ')$this->col++;
            if ($this->col<strlen($s) && $s[$this->col] !== ';')return false;
            $this->skip();
        }
        return true;
    }
    private function token(): array {
        if ($this->end())throw new Exception('unexpected end of input');
        $s = $this->lines[$this->row];
        $c = $s[$this->col++];
        if (str_contains("()'", $c))return [$c, null];
        if ($c === '"'){
            $v = '';
            while ($this->col<strlen($s)){
                $c = $s[$this->col++];
                if ($c === '"')return ['v', $v];
                if ($c === "\\"){
                    if ($this->col === strlen($s))break;
                    $c = $s[$this->col++];
                    if (!in_array($c, ['"', "\\", 'n'], true))throw new Exception('bad escape');
                    $v .= $c === 'n'?"\n": $c;
                }else $v .= $c;
            }
            throw new Exception('unterminated string');
        }
        $start = $this->col-1;
        while ($this->col<strlen($s) && !str_contains(" ()'\";", $s[$this->col]))$this->col++;
        $a = substr($s, $start, $this->col-$start);
        if ($a === '.')return ['.', null];
        if (preg_match('/^[+-]?[0-9]+$/D', $a))return ['v', (int)$a];
        if ($a === '#t' || $a === '#f')return ['v', $a === '#t'];
        if ($a[0] === '#')throw new Exception('bad token: '.$a);
        return ['v', sym($a)];
    }
    public function datum(?array $t = null): mixed {
        $t??=$this->token();
        if ($t[0] === 'v')return $t[1];
        if ($t[0] === "'")return makeList([sym('quote'), $this->datum()]);
        if ($t[0] !== '(')throw new Exception('unexpected '.$t[0]);
        $a = [];
        while (true){
            $t = $this->token();
            if ($t[0] === ')')return makeList($a);
            if ($t[0] === '.' && $a){
                $tail = $this->datum();
                if ($this->token()[0] !== ')')throw new Exception('expected )');
                return makeList($a, $tail);
            }
            $a[] = $this->datum($t);
        }
    }
}
$lines = [];
while (($s = fgets(STDIN)) !== false){
    $s = rtrim($s, "\r\n");
    if ($s === '(exit)')break;
    $lines[] = $s;
}
$reader = new Reader($lines);
$env = globalEnv();
while (!$reader->end()){
    try{
        $x = $reader->datum();
    }catch (Exception $err){
        writeLine('Error: read: '.$err->getMessage());
        if ($err->getMessage() === 'unexpected end of input')break;
        $reader->skip();
        continue;
    }
    try{
        $v = evaluate($x, $env);
        if ($v !== $void)writeLine(rep($v));
    }catch (Exception $err){
        writeLine('Error: '.$err->getMessage());
    }
}
if ($mid)writeText("\n");
